sources.title: Children Rising Inc - ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer

profile.summary: Children Rising is an Oakland nonprofit that provides one-on-one reading and math tutoring to elementary school students in Oakland. It also offers family support services. Its programs include Succeeding by Reading, Path2Math and FamilyBridge.
